```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(NlsyLinks)
library(discord)
library(gtsummary)
library(broom)
library(broom.helpers)
library(janitor)
library(targets)
#' Reverse Code Survey Items
#'
#' @description From https://github.com/svmiller/stevemisc/blob/master/R/revcode.R
#' @param x A vector of survey items
reverse_code <- function(x) {
  len <- length(na.omit(unique(x)))+1
  return((x*-1) + len)
}

# Set the url for neuroticism data
neuroticism_data_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/R-Computing-Lab/target-causalclaims/main/data/neuroticism.csv"

# Read in the raw data
processed_neuroticism_data <- read_csv(
  neuroticism_data_url
) %>%
  # Select the variables, renaming them according to the fields from NLSY
  select(
    case_id = R0000100,
    sample_id = R0173600,
    race = R0214700,
    sex = R0214800,
    depression = H0013301, # H0013301 is depression at age 50
    anxious_upset = T4998603,
    calm_stable = T4998608
    ) %>%
  # Filter the data frame so we only have values greater than zero in the columns 'depression_score', 'anxious_upset', and 'calm_stable'
    filter(
      if_all(
        .cols = c(depression, anxious_upset, calm_stable), 
        function(value) value >= 0)
      ) %>%
  # Define neuroticism and scale relevant measures
    mutate(
      depression = scale(depression)[,1],
      # Reverse Coding calm/stable measurement from TIPI and adding with
      # anxious/upset
      neuroticism = scale(
        reverse_code(calm_stable) + anxious_upset
        )[,1]
      ) 


single_entered_neuroticism <- processed_neuroticism_data %>%
  mutate(
    SubjectTag = case_id * 100
    ) %>%
    CreatePairLinksSingleEntered(
      # Get familial links from the NLSY79 dataset for full siblings
      linksPairDataset = Links79PairExpanded %>%
        filter(
          RelationshipPath == "Gen1Housemates" & RFull == 0.5
          ),
      linksNames = c(
        "ExtendedID",
        "R", 
        "RelationshipPath"
        ),
      outcomeNames = c(
        "depression", 
        "neuroticism",
        "sex", 
        "race"
        ),
      subject1Qualifier = "_s1",
      subject2Qualifier = "_s2"
      ) %>%
    # NAs in outcome variable cannot be present for discordant regression to work
    drop_na(
      contains("depression")
      ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(
      subject_tag_s1 = SubjectTag_S1,
      subject_tag_s2 = SubjectTag_S2,
      extended_id = ExtendedID,
      relationship_path = RelationshipPath
    )  %>%
  mutate(id = row_number())
```


# Depression and Neuroticism

```{r}
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

z_cut <- .33

df_link <- single_entered_neuroticism

consistent_kin <- df_link %>%
  group_by(subject_tag_s1, subject_tag_s2) %>%
  count(
    depression_s1, neuroticism_s1,
    depression_s2, neuroticism_s2) %>%
  na.omit()

# Create the dep_modeling_data object with only consistent responders.
# Clean the column names with the {janitor} package.
dep_modeling_data <- semi_join(df_link,
  consistent_kin,
  by = c(
    "subject_tag_s1",
    "subject_tag_s2"
  )
) %>%
  clean_names()

discord_dep <- discord_data(
        data = single_entered_neuroticism,
        outcome = "depression",
        predictors = "neuroticism",
        sex = "sex",
        race = "race",
        pair_identifiers = c("_s1", "_s2"),
        id = "id"
      ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(neuroticism_mean), !is.na(depression_mean)) %>%
  mutate(
    # # Classify Difference Grouping
    neuroticism_diff_group = factor(
      case_when(
        scale(neuroticism_diff) > z_cut  ~ "More N",
        scale(neuroticism_diff) < -z_cut  ~ "Less N",
        abs(scale(neuroticism_diff)) <= z_cut  ~ "Equally N"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Less N",
        "Equally N",
        "More N"
      )
    )
  )

```


```{r}

# Create a color palette for the shading
shading <- c("firebrick4", "firebrick1", "dodgerblue1", "dodgerblue4")
max_val <- max(abs(discord_dep$neuroticism_diff), na.rm = TRUE)
values <- seq(-max_val, max_val, length = length(shading))
```


```{r individual, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
# Individual level plot
individual_plot <- ggplot(dep_modeling_data, aes(
  x = neuroticism_s1,
  y = depression_s1,
  color = neuroticism_s1 - neuroticism_s2
)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0.1)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  # added sibling 2 to the plot
  geom_point(
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE,
    position = position_jitter(w = 0.1, h = 0.1),
    aes(
      x = neuroticism_s2,
      y = depression_s2,
      color = neuroticism_s2 - neuroticism_s1
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    name = "Sibling\nDifferences\nin Neuroticism",
    colours = shading,
    na.value = "#AD78B6",
    values = scales::rescale(c(-max_val, max_val))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Neuroticism Score",
    y = "CES-D Depression Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() #+
#  theme(legend.position = "none")

individual_plot +
  ggtitle("Individual Level Plot") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r plot-raw-data, message=FALSE}
# Marginal X density (SES mean)
xdensity <- ggplot(discord_dep, aes(x = neuroticism_mean, group = neuroticism_diff_group, color = neuroticism_diff_group)) +
  geom_density(adjust = 2, linewidth = 1, fill = NA) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Sibling\nDifferences\nin Neuroticism",
    values = c("firebrick1", "#AD78B6", "dodgerblue1")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "left",
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

# Marginal Y density
ydensity <- ggplot(discord_dep, aes(x = depression_mean, group = neuroticism_diff_group, color = neuroticism_diff_group)) +
  geom_density(adjust = 2, linewidth = 1, fill = NA) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("firebrick1", "#AD78B6", "dodgerblue1")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```



```{r}
df_link <- single_entered_conscientiousness_income 

consistent_kin <- df_link %>%
  group_by(subject_tag_s1, subject_tag_s2) %>%
  count(
    depression_s1, conscientiousness_s1,
    depression_s2, conscientiousness_s2) %>%
  na.omit()

# Create the dep_modeling_data object with only consistent responders.
# Clean the column names with the {janitor} package.
depincome_modeling_data <- semi_join(df_link,
  consistent_kin,
  by = c(
    "subject_tag_s1",
    "subject_tag_s2"
  )
) %>%
  clean_names()

discord_depincome <- discord_data(
        data = single_entered_conscientiousness_income ,
        outcome = "depression",
        predictors = c("conscientiousness","tnfi_at_age_50","highest_grade_at_age_50"),
        sex = "sex",
        race = "race",
        pair_identifiers = c("_s1", "_s2"),
        id = "id"
      ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(conscientiousness_mean), !is.na(depression_mean)) %>%
  mutate(
    # # Classify Difference Grouping
    conscientiousness_diff_group = factor(
      case_when(
        scale(conscientiousness_diff) > z_cut  ~ "More C",
        scale(conscientiousness_diff) < -z_cut  ~ "Less C",
        abs(scale(conscientiousness_diff)) <= z_cut  ~ "Equally C"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Less C",
        "Equally C",
        "More C"
      )
    )
  )
    model_control_means <- lm(depression_mean ~ tnfi_at_age_50_mean + highest_grade_at_age_50_mean , data = discord_depincome)
    
discord_depincome$depression_mean_partialed[!is.na(discord_depincome$depression_mean)&!is.na(discord_depincome$tnfi_at_age_50_mean)&!is.na(discord_depincome$highest_grade_at_age_50_mean)] <-  residuals(model_control_means)

model_control_diff <- lm(depression_diff ~ tnfi_at_age_50_diff + highest_grade_at_age_50_diff , data = discord_depincome)
    
discord_depincome$depression_diff_partialed[!is.na(discord_depincome$depression_diff)&!is.na(discord_depincome$tnfi_at_age_50_diff)&!is.na(discord_depincome$highest_grade_at_age_50_diff)] <-  residuals(model_control_diff)

```

```{r}
df_link <- single_entered_conscientiousness

# Create the dep_modeling_data object with only consistent responders.

  consistent_kin,
  by = c(

  clean_names()

discord_h50 <- discord_data(
        data = single_entered_conscientiousness,
        outcome = "age_50_physical_health",
        predictors = "conscientiousness",
        sex = "sex",
        race = "race",
        pair_identifiers = c("_s1", "_s2"),
        id = "id"
      ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(conscientiousness_mean), !is.na(age_50_physical_health_mean)) %>%
  mutate(
    # # Classify Difference Grouping
    conscientiousness_diff_group = factor(
      case_when(
        scale(conscientiousness_diff) > z_cut  ~ "More C",
        scale(conscientiousness_diff) < -z_cut  ~ "Less C",
        abs(scale(conscientiousness_diff)) <= z_cut  ~ "Equally C"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Less C",
        "Equally C",
        "More C"
      )
    )
  )

```


```{r}
# Create a color palette for the shading
shading <- c("firebrick4", "firebrick1", "dodgerblue1", "dodgerblue4")
max_val <- max(abs(discord_h50$conscientiousness_diff), na.rm = TRUE)
values <- seq(-max_val, max_val, length = length(shading))
```

```{r individual, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
# Individual level plot

individual_plot <- ggplot(h50_modeling_data, aes(
  x = conscientiousness_s1,
  y = age_50_physical_health_s1,
  color = conscientiousness_s1 - conscientiousness_s2
)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0.1)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  # added sibling 2 to the plot
  geom_point(
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE,
    position = position_jitter(w = 0.1, h = 0.1),
    aes(
      x = conscientiousness_s2,
      y = age_50_physical_health_s2,
      color = conscientiousness_s2 - conscientiousness_s1
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    name = "Sibling\nDifferences\nin conscientiousness",
    colours = shading,
    na.value = "#AD78B6",
    values = scales::rescale(c(-max_val, max_val))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "conscientiousness Score",
    y = "age_50_physical_health Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() #+
#  theme(legend.position = "none")

individual_plot +
  ggtitle("Individual Level Plot") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r plot-raw-data, message=FALSE}
# Marginal X density (SES mean)

  scale_colour_manual(

  theme(

    axis.title.y = element_blank(),

  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

# Marginal Y density
ydensity <- ggplot(discord_h50, aes(x = age_50_physical_health_mean, group = conscientiousness_diff_group, color = conscientiousness_diff_group)) +
  geom_density(adjust = 2, linewidth = 1, fill = NA) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## Setup: Use discord_data

# Main scatter plot
main_plot_within <- ggplot(discord_h50, aes(
  x = conscientiousness_diff,
  y = age_50_physical_health_diff, colour = conscientiousness_diff
)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE,
    position = position_jitter(w = 0.2, h = 0.2)

  # add regression line y = .05+ .02x
  geom_ribbon(stat = "identity",aes(ymin = 0.921 - 0.015 * conscientiousness_diff - 0.01, ymax = 0.921 + 0.114 * conscientiousness_diff + 0.02), alpha = 0.3,color = "black",
              linetype = 0
              ) +
      geom_abline(slope = 0.01, intercept = 0.921, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    name = "Sibling\nDifferences\nin conscientiousness",
    colours = shading,
    na.value = "#AD78B6",
    values = scales::rescale(c(
      min(discord_h50$conscientiousness_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(discord_h50$conscientiousness_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(discord_h50$conscientiousness_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    ))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "left") +
```
